units.source_text: 我不由的一边哭，一边打着哥哥。

en.t: I could not help crying as I hit my brother.

units.source_text: 当时，我全然忘了哥哥是个脾气暴躁的人。

en.t: At that moment, I had completely forgotten that my brother was a hot-tempered man.

units.source_text: 就在我的手刚要落到哥哥身上之前，哥哥打了我一个耳光。

en.t: Just before my hand was about to land on my brother, he slapped me across the face.
